problems.description: Employees receive emails impersonating executives requesting urgent wire transfers or sensitive information, leveraging social engineering to bypass normal verification.
risk_reduction: Implement email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Train employees to verify unusual requests through separate communication channels
Use advanced email filtering solutions to detect spoofed senders

problems.description: Phishing emails contain malicious attachments that, when opened, install ransomware or keyloggers on corporate endpoints.
risk_reduction: Deploy endpoint protection with real-time malware scanning
Block or sandbox email attachments from unknown senders
Conduct regular phishing awareness campaigns and simulated attacks

problems.description: Spear phishing campaigns target high-value employees with personalized messages to steal credentials or install backdoors.
risk_reduction: Use multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all privileged accounts
Limit access to sensitive information on a need-to-know basis
Monitor login patterns and alert on anomalous access attempts

problems.description: Attackers send phishing emails that mimic cloud service providers, tricking users into entering credentials on fake login pages to gain unauthorized cloud access.
risk_reduction: Enable MFA on all cloud accounts
Educate users on recognizing legitimate provider communications
Use browser-based anti-phishing tools and URL filtering

problems.description: Phishing campaigns target cloud administrators with links to malicious sites that exploit browser vulnerabilities to steal session tokens.
risk_reduction: Keep browsers and plugins updated with security patches
Use hardware security keys for authentication
Implement session timeout and anomaly detection on cloud consoles

problems.description: Compromised cloud user credentials from phishing lead to unauthorized deployment of malicious workloads or data exfiltration.
risk_reduction: Enforce least privilege access and role-based access control (RBAC)
Monitor cloud activity logs for unusual behavior
Rotate credentials regularly and revoke unused accounts

problems.description: Individuals receive SMS or email messages impersonating banks or service providers, prompting them to disclose personal information or click malicious links.
risk_reduction: Verify sender authenticity before responding or clicking links
Use mobile security apps with phishing detection
Enable MFA on personal accounts where available

problems.description: Phishing websites mimic popular social media or e-commerce platforms to steal login credentials and personal data.
risk_reduction: Check website URLs carefully before entering credentials
Use password managers to autofill only on legitimate sites
Keep devices and browsers updated with security patches

problems.description: Voice phishing (vishing) calls impersonate trusted entities to extract sensitive information such as credit card numbers or social security details.
risk_reduction: Do not share sensitive information over unsolicited calls
Verify caller identity independently before responding
Register on do-not-call lists and use call-blocking features
